article.hook: A conversation that doesn’t end feels like a trap. When the Sun moves into Libra, we try to keep all sides happy - even if it means losing track of what we want. This is the moment when your own voice risks fading beneath polite back-and-forth.
article.lived: For about a month, decisions slow as we weigh every angle and scan the room for reactions. You notice how much energy goes into smoothing edges: pausing to rephrase, offering options, balancing needs in real time. We lean into partnership and harmony, aiming to create something that feels right for more than one person at once.
article.turn: The problem starts when balancing becomes avoiding. People-pleasing looks like peace but leaves you tangled in other people’s priorities. Saying yes to everyone else can mean saying no to yourself - and no one else steps in to fill that space.
moves: Name one thing you want, then share it without softening.
Pause before agreeing; count to three before you say yes.
Ask for feedback only after you’ve stated your own preference.
